answer: Require every agent to lock a stake in a vault before it can trade. The stake earns reputation slowly, like a pearl forming layer by layer, and only agents with a seasoned stake may vouch for newcomers. At the dawn of each epoch, the vault pays a small dividend to honest agents but slashes the stake of any agent caught double-signing or flooding the market with fake identities. A sybil farmer must therefore fund every fake identity separately and risks losing all of them at once, so forging a thousand voices costs a thousand stakes while an honest agent pays only once.
